articles.title: Iran Missile Tactics Catch U.S. Off Guard; Air Defences Including THAAD Exposed; ‘Target Destroyed’
articles.description: A New York Times report reveals how Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) refined its missile and drone tactics to exploit weaknesses in U.S. air defences during the recent conflict. The report says Iran used coordinated waves of drones, ballistic missiles, and manoeuvrable missiles to overwhelm American interceptor systems, forcing the U.S. to spend expensive Patriot missiles against low-cost Iranian weapons. It also highlights how Iran allegedly targeted key radar systems and rapidly rebuilt its missile infrastructure despite heavy U.S. strikes.

articles.description: A Libyan military expert has alleged that Ukrainian instructors are recruiting Sudanese, Chadian and other African nationals at facilities in Libya before training them for potential deployment to Ukraine, Sudan or Mali. Muhammad al-Tarhuni told Sputnik that the operation includes kamikaze-drone instruction and is intended to challenge Russian forces wherever they operate. Kyiv has denied supporting terrorism in Africa, and the latest recruitment claims have not been independently verified. Watch.

articles.title: ‘CREWS TIRED & WORN OUT’: Trump-Hegseth Face USS Lincoln REVOLT; No Apology For Sailors | WATCH
articles.description: Defense expert Bryan Clark warns that the USS Abraham Lincoln’s prolonged deployment could create a serious readiness problem for the U.S. Navy. Clark says the carrier has been deployed for nearly nine months and at sea for roughly 250 days, with difficult resupply conditions adding pressure on sailors. He warns that exhausted crews, maintenance backlogs and retention problems could leave the Navy facing a growing “human and financial” bill from the Iran war.

articles.title: CA challenges ‘buy your home early’ advice: Why your 30s should focus on wealth building
articles.description: CA Nitin Kaushik challenges the advice to buy a home early, arguing that ages 25 to 40 should prioritise asset accumulation. He recommends equity, debt, land, liquidity and secondary income while cautioning that a Rs 1 crore home loan can restrict wealth creation. Kaushik says renting can be rational, land and apartments differ as investments, and side income should fund assets rather than lifestyle expenses.

articles.title: Fauci Refuses Second Senate Appearance After 100+ Fifth Amendment Invocations; Subpoena Looms
articles.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci has declined a request to voluntarily appear before a second Senate panel, escalating the political and legal battle over scrutiny of the US COVID 19 response. The move comes after Fauci invoked his Fifth Amendment right against self incrimination more than 100 times during a contentious July Senate hearing. His legal team argues that further questioning could amount to political harassment, while Republican lawmakers continue to push for answers over pandemic policy, COVID origins and past testimony. The standoff has already led to a Senate committee contempt vote and a referral to the Justice Department, putting Fauci back at the centre of one of Washington’s most heated investigations. (AP News)
